name: 🖼 博物馆·画廊
desc: 票务·参观规则·寄存·展区·导览·语音导览·特展·摄影·闭馆·会员

items.en: The museum is free on Sundays.
items.zh: 博物馆周日免费。

items.en: Please do not touch the paintings.
items.zh: 请勿触摸画作。

items.en: Tickets are sold at the entrance.
items.zh: 门票在入口处出售。

items.en: The gift shop closes at six.
items.zh: 礼品店六点关门。

items.en: Photography is allowed without flash.
items.zh: 允许拍照，但不能用闪光灯。

items.en: Please keep your ticket with you.
items.zh: 请随身保管好门票。

items.en: The east wing is closed today.
items.zh: 东翼展厅今天关闭。

items.en: Large bags must be left at the entrance.
items.zh: 大件行李必须寄存在入口处。

items.en: The modern art gallery is on the second floor.
items.zh: 现代艺术展厅在二楼。

items.en: Guided tours start every hour near the front desk.
items.zh: 导览每小时在服务台附近开始。

items.en: The special exhibition upstairs requires a separate ticket.
items.zh: 楼上的特展需要另外购票。

items.en: You can store your coat in the lockers downstairs.
items.zh: 你可以把外套存在楼下的储物柜里。

items.en: Members enter for free through the side door.
items.zh: 会员可从侧门免费入场。

items.en: The audio guide is available in five languages.
items.zh: 语音导览提供五种语言。

items.en: If you want an audio guide, you can rent one at the ticket counter.
items.zh: 如果你想要语音导览，可以在售票台租一个。
chunks: If you want an audio guide

items.en: The sculptures, which were donated last year, are displayed in the east wing.
items.zh: 这些去年捐赠的雕塑陈列在东翼展厅。
chunks: are displayed in the east wing

items.en: When the museum closes, a bell rings so visitors can find the exit.
items.zh: 闭馆时会响铃，方便参观者找到出口。
chunks: so visitors can find the exit

items.en: If you become a member, you can visit every special exhibition for free.
items.zh: 如果你成为会员，就能免费参观每一场特展。
chunks: you can visit every special exhibition

items.en: Visitors who bring large backpacks must check them at the coat room first.
items.zh: 携带大背包的参观者须先在寄存处存放。

items.en: Because the special show is popular, please book your time slot online in advance.
items.zh: 由于特展很受欢迎，请提前在网上预约入场时段。
chunks: Because the special show is popular

items.en: The photographs that hang in the main hall may not be touched or moved.
items.zh: 挂在主展厅的这些照片不得触摸或移动。
chunks: that hang in the main hall
may not be touched or moved
